cards.name: Month summary
cards.sql: select budget_month, currency, income, total_actual, cycle_start, cycle_end, cycle_open, days_left, cash_in_hand from month_summaries [[where budget_month = {{budget_month}}]] order by budget_month desc, currency

cards.name: Spent per category (UAH)
cards.sql: select coalesce(category, 'Uncategorized') as category, sum(amount_uah) as amount_uah from ledger_entries where direction <> 'income' and status in ('kept', 'unresolved') and budget_month is not null [[and budget_month = {{budget_month}}]] group by category order by amount_uah
